o.text: Possibly a derivation from Proto-Turkic *bora- (“north wind; to snow heavily”). Cognate with Turkish bora, Crimean Tatar and Turkmen boran, Bashkir буран (boran), Kazakh боран (boran), Kyrgyz & Southern Altai бороон (boroon).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *tōr- (“young of an animal”). See more at Turkish torun.
From Proto-Common Turkic *yas- (“flat and broad”). Cognate with Turkish yassı, Turkmen ýasy, Uyghur يېسسى (yëssi), يېسە (yëse), etc.

glosses: a kind of wild plant, probably glasswort
